answer: Jury seats open only to identities older than 55 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. The forge register is checked at draw time, oasis lists the eligible set, and zenith seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 55 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an attacker pays for every seat it wants. A 106 account operation therefore ties up 32 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
